title: Goodles mac and cheese with meatballs, green beans
ingredients: 4 boxes Goodles mac and cheese, plus the milk and butter the box calls for
BBQ sauce, a light drizzle (it's sugary)
(2) 12 oz bags frozen cut green beans

steps.do: Heat the oven and put the meatballs in first, per the bag (about 20 minutes).
Meanwhile cook the Goodles per the box.
need: milk and butter, per the box

steps.do: Steam the green beans in the microwave and season with salt, pepper and a little butter.
need: salt, pepper and a little butter

steps.do: Toss the meatballs with a little BBQ sauce and serve with the mac and green beans.
